'''Lain-Ricie''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Nautolan/Legends|Nautolan]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. She was a [[Merchant/Legends|vendor]] who operated along the [[Woodland Path]] within the [[Juran Mountains/Legends|Juran Mountains]] on [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]].<ref name="tor" />

==Behind the scenes==
In ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', she sells an [[Magnetically Guided Grappling System]] for 10,000 credits and a [[Red Detonite Actuator]] for 2,000 credits which are both required in order to obtain two [[Datacron/Legends|datacrons]].<ref name="tor" />
